Title: Login with valid standard user
Steps:
1. Open /shop
2. Enter username demo_user and password Demo@123
3. Click Login
Expected result: Redirected to /shop/products and 12 product cards are shown

Title: Buy a product end to end
Steps:
1. Log in as demo_user
2. Add Aurora Wireless Headphones to cart
3. Open cart and click Checkout
4. Fill all shipping fields and card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/30, CVV 123
5. Accept terms and Place order
Expected result: Success page shows an order id matching NS-<digits>

Title: Apply SAVE10 coupon
Steps:
1. Add any product to cart
2. Enter SAVE10 and Apply
Expected result: Discount line shows 10% of the subtotal and the total drops accordingly

Title: Sort products by price low to high
Steps:
1. Log in
2. Choose Price (low to high) in sort
Expected result: Product prices are in ascending order

Title: Search narrows the grid
Steps:
1. Log in
2. Type headphones in search
Expected result: Exactly 1 product card is shown and the count text updates

Title: Order appears in history
Expected result: The new order id is listed in the orders table

Title: Wrong password is rejected
Steps:
1. Enter demo_user with password wrong
2. Click Login
Expected result: Error "Username and password do not match any user in this service"

Title: Locked user cannot log in
Expected result: Error "Sorry, this user has been locked out."

Title: Empty login form
Steps: 1. Click Login with both fields empty

Title: Invalid coupon code
Expected result: Error says the coupon is not valid and no discount is applied

Title: Declined card
Expected result: Payment error is shown and no order is created

Title: Checkout with empty form
Steps: 1. Click Place order without filling anything
Expected result: An error summary plus an error under every required field

Title: FLAT20 below the $100 threshold
Expected result: Rejected with "FLAT20 needs a subtotal of at least $100"

Title: Slow user login
Expected result: Products page loads after ~3 s (the test must wait, not sleep)

Title: Maximum quantity in cart
Steps:
1. Add a low-stock product until the cart holds all its stock
2. Open its product page
Expected result: Button reads "Max quantity in cart" and is disabled

Title: Guest to paid order with coupon
Steps:
1. Open /shop and log in as demo_user / Demo@123
2. Search "headphones" and add Aurora Wireless Headphones to the cart
3. Open the cart and apply coupon SAVE10
4. Checkout with valid shipping details and card 4242 4242 4242 4242, 12/30, 123
5. Accept terms and place the order
6. Open Orders
Expected result: Success page shows an NS-<digits> order id, the discount is applied, and the same order appears first in the orders table

Title: Declined card then cash on delivery
Steps:
1. Log in and add two products
2. Checkout with the declined card 4000 0000 0000 0002
3. Observe the payment error
4. Switch to Cash on delivery and place the order again
Expected result: First attempt shows a payment error with no order created; the second succeeds and only one order is listed in history

Title: Cart survives navigation and logout rules
Steps:
1. Log in and add 3 items
2. Change a quantity in the cart
3. Navigate to a product page and back
4. Log out
5. Try to open /shop/cart directly
Expected result: Cart badge and totals stay consistent while navigating; after logout /shop/cart redirects to the login page
